title: Phase 2: Enhance AI parser with DB vocabulary
description:
AI parser needs access to dynamic data from domain layer per spec:

## Required AI Inputs:
1. Container units list from DB
2. Known stores, brands, properties lists from DB  
3. Item library with canonical names and categories
4. Size units list from code enum
5. Example input/output pairs

## Current State:
- AI parser uses static prompts only
- No dynamic vocabulary injection
- Missing DB-driven fuzzy matching validation

## Implementation:
1. Update AiParser constructor to accept domain services
2. Create vocabulary aggregation function from domain constants
3. Modify prompt generation to include dynamic vocabulary
4. Add validation of AI results using domain fuzzy matching
5. Update AI parser to pass vocabulary to AI model
